statement: let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; ∀ n : ℕ, IsClosed (wideArcs n)

plain_statement.zh: 宽弧带 wideArcs n 是闭集：它是有限个闭区间的并。
plain_statement.en: The wide-arc band wideArcs n is closed: a finite union of closed intervals.

brief.zh: 把 q≤Q₁ n、a≤q 两重存在量词写成有限并，每段 {t | |t−a/q| ≤ H/(qn)} 是闭区间，再用有限并的闭性。用于说明角胞积分的指标函数可测、补集为开集。仍缺：这些弧的总测度与例外模数估计。
brief.en: Rewrite the two existential quantifiers over q≤Q₁ n and a≤q as a finite union, note each piece {t | |t−a/q| ≤ H/(qn)} is a closed interval, and apply closedness under finite unions. This makes the indicator measurable and its complement open. Still missing: total arc measure and exceptional moduli.
